# The earlier theory folders

The sixteen folders beside `becoming/` hold the earlier theories: syntheses first written in September 2026 and kept in place, some with later additions, each first written before the live account, [the theory of becoming](becoming/ONE-PAGE.md). A folder's own assessments of standing and readiness are its view when it was written, not the live account's, and each folder's README says so in a banner above its text as it was. [Chapter 5](becoming/chapters/05-COLLECTIVES.md#11-joint-plans-and-applications) counts five of them among applications elsewhere: design programmes, not results; correspondence not established.

Each row links the folder's section of [the crosswalk](becoming/results/atlas/CROSSWALK.md): what it claimed in its own terms, and what became of that in the live account. The crosswalk creates no result, and every entry is an AI reading with no person's behind it. A shared word is not a correspondence, structural agreement is not agreement in meaning, and not carried is an outcome, not a defect. A second critic read 100 entries drawn at random against both sides; weighted by how many entries each kind holds, that estimates 82.6% holding, 14.2% with a label or a target's role wrong and 3.2% with a wrong reading over all 1183.
